projectDescription: A real-time earthquake relief coordination map for Manizales and Villamaría, Colombia, helping volunteers find where help is needed today.
keyFeatures: Real-time interactive map with MapLibre GL, showing aid sites, work orders, animals, and resource offers
Neighborhood-aware data — every pin is automatically assigned to one of Manizales's 114 official barrios via PostGIS trigger
Anonymous public reporting — anyone can report a need or site without an account
Work order lifecycle — community-driven status derived from a thread of updates (on_the_way, helped, still_needed, not_real)
Unified panel with category chips (Todo, Sitios, Mascotas, Servicios, Necesidades) replacing multi-route navigation
Confidence system — unconfirmed reports are shown but visually demoted rather than hidden
Google Sign-In for curator and contributor roles, required only for actions that commit others
Structured logging with automatic redaction of phone numbers and addresses
Row-level security via Supabase + PostGIS, with security_invoker views to prevent RLS bypass
Open-publication model — items go live immediately and are moderated down by curators
publicApiSurface: SiteDAL.public() — read published sites with neighborhood, status, items, and confirmation count
SiteDAL.create() — authenticated DAL for curator-level site creation
SiteDAL.listPublished() — list sites visible to current role
SiteDAL.findNearby() — proximity check using PostGIS, called for duplicate detection
WorkOrderDAL.public() — read published work orders with attendee/helped counts and thread
WorkOrderDAL.create() — create anonymous work order report
WorkOrderDAL.postUpdate() — post an update entry (on_the_way, helped, still_needed, not_real)
ResourceOfferDAL.public() — read published resource offers
ResourceOfferDAL.create() — create anonymous resource offer
AnimalDAL.public() — read published animal reports
AnimalDAL.create() — create anonymous animal report
NeighborhoodDAL — list neighborhoods for barrio picker and panel filtering
createSiteSchema / createWorkOrderSchema / createResourceOfferSchema / createAnimalSchema — Zod input validation
